description: This file defines the TemporalExpressionPrinter class, which implements a visitor pattern for pretty-printing various TemporalExpression types in a calendar or scheduling context.

classes.name: TemporalExpressionPrinter
classes.description: A class that implements the TemporalExpressionVisitor interface to generate a human-readable string representation of TemporalExpression objects.

methods.name: appendExpression
methods.description: Appends a string representation of a TemporalExpression to the StringBuilder with proper indentation.

methods.name: appendIndent
methods.description: Adds indentation spaces to the StringBuilder based on currentIndent.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Increases current indentation level by indentSize.

methods.name: unIndent
methods.description: Decreases current indentation level by indentSize.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates and returns the pretty-printed string of the associated TemporalExpression.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Implements visitor methods for various TemporalExpression subclasses to append their string representations.
